why: pve-qa (owner report 2026-10-27, item 4): dungeon names in the room 'choose dungeon' modal show in another language. Root cause: DungeonChooseMapView.solveTitlePath() renders the dungeon title as a loaded BITMAP (`image/map/<Pve_Info.ID>/icon.png`, baked art from the original SWF export, vendor/DDTank41 'Source Flash' src/room/view/chooseMap/DungeonChooseMapView.as:671/811) -- never as text. That art is read-only (apps/client/public/assets junction) and was never retranslated; meanwhile game."Pve_Info".Name/Description ARE already 100% pt-BR translated in the DB (docs/BACKLOG.md 'Localizacao PT-BR': Pve_Info.Name 33/33, Description 24/24, overlay applied in apps/game/src/db/templates.ts + MapManager on the client), so the data the player actually needs is already correct and available via MapManager.getDungeonInfo(mapId) -- it just never reaches this screen as readable text. Minimal, low-risk fix: prepend the translated Name as a visible first line of the existing, already-correctly-positioned/styled `_dungeonDescriptionTxt` panel (same text component the Description already renders into), instead of touching the baked bitmap or guessing new overlay geometry over unverified art bounds.
